sourceOccurrences.label: Finite witnesses and Harris applications
sourceOccurrences.note: 22S9 covers finite intersections. H4OA and 5CN6 cover upper-set and finite-witness arguments; the connection and escape discussion retains arbitrary vertex subsets. X5SS applies to pairs of connection, escape and infinite-cluster events, including a mixed connection/infinite-cluster pair. UPFU is the three-point lower bound. Cluster growth and path witnesses supply the graph monotonicity steps. The larger Harris module and its general ordered-coordinate integration helpers are not included in this module census.
